items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1973-03-16
items.q: But only when I was playing at the Club Forest. I was playing with Marty Rapp.

ctx.x: Yes. But only when I was playing at the Club Forest. I was playing with Marty Rapp. And he was campaigning. And we couldn't leave the bandstand, well we couldn't get too far away, because every, after that, whenever he finished something, he said, I'll take you back to the Club Forest and Marty Rapp's off, and we danced from a bandstand and played something, you know. He got free music all the time between his speeches. But I never did meet Huey Long. Earl Long, I played a favorite. I used to go up there and play…
Was he a music fancier himself, Earl Long?
